product_from_film: Salesgraph gathers sales context and prepares deal insights and collateral, delivered through a Slack interface to help representatives manage strategic deals.
explains_well: The script identifies context retrieval and collateral building, while the later message example shows discovery gaps and action items.
unclear: The film spends most of its time explaining the sales-support model but does not trace one source conversation into a recommendation, collateral asset or completed deal action.
scenario: A founder describes sales difficulties, a diagram explains traditional support roles, and Salesgraph is introduced as a connected layer delivering deal guidance in Slack.
product_clear_basis: The inspected ASR explicitly says context retrieval and collateral building at 20s; the first concrete message output is much later at 79–81s.

sound.detail: The draft coherently describes strategic sales, context retrieval, collateral, data/tool connections and Slack delivery. Several names and source terms are garbled, and part of the marketing/outbound explanation is missing; visible diagrams support the broad categories. No validated listening, delivery, music, effects or sync assessment.

categories.finding: Silent viewing can identify sales roles and a message output but loses much of the actual proposition during the long presenter sections.
The centered presenter and sparse diagrams are easy to locate visually; the message is the key concrete artifact and receives relatively little time.
About 42s passes before explanatory graphics; the concrete message arrives around 79s and is followed by another long presenter close.
The sales problem is answered by a discovery/action list, but no source-to-recommendation or recommendation-to-result loop is completed.
Founder presence and the team-behind-each-rep idea may communicate support; response is unmeasured.
The roles/gap explanation is coherent, but the product output is not tied to a specific deal input or changed action.
Broad tool coverage, agent scale, unified support and closing-deal benefits are film claims. Recommendation quality, integrations and sales results were not tested.
The three-role map gives a specific organizational framing for the unified sales layer.
